verdict.hook_line: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A betrayed soldier uncovers a political conspiracy that the current rulers of Ashwood orchestrated his ambush.
verdict.why_it_works: Builds massive dramatic tension and transitions a personal reunion into a sweeping political revenge plot.
